phone.title: Phone
phone.explain: A paired phone controls SENTINEL through your server's phone view: approvals, modes, routines, programs, Jarvis, undo, autonomy and releasing the emergency stop. Every command is signed with a key only the phone and this PC know.
phone.open: On the iPhone open in Safari, "Share → Add to Home Screen", then open the app:
phone.confirmUnpair: Unpair the phone? It can then only read and trigger the emergency stop.
phone.codeOnce: Type this code into the phone app under "Pair phone" now. It is shown only once and stored nowhere.
phone.security: Releasing the emergency stop, changing autonomy and PIN actions also ask for your owner PIN on the phone – it is checked only here on the PC. Pairing again invalidates the old phone.

mic.title: Microphone & voice
mic.silent: No sound arrived. Choose another microphone or see "Help" below.
mic.helpTitle: Help: the microphone delivers no sound
mic.help1: Check the laptop mute key (ASUS often F9 or Fn+F9; the light must be off).
mic.help2: Windows: Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone → turn on "Microphone access" and "Let desktop apps access your microphone".
mic.help3: Windows: Settings → System → Sound → Input → choose the microphone, volume at least 70, press "Test".
mic.help4: Headset (e.g. Arctis): turn it on, connect it, then "Reload list" here and select it.
